title: ProMemAgent: Long-Horizon Proactive Assistance with Context-Aware Prospective Memory from Sensory Perceptions
abstract: arXiv:2610.27400v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are moving beyond reactive responses toward proactive assistance that anticipates user needs without explicit requests. However, existing proactive agents primarily address immediate needs, while many everyday situations involve delayed intentions that can only be acted on hours or days later. Humans handle such intentions through prospective memory, the ability to remember to act on an intention when the right moment arises. In this paper, we introduce ProMemAgent, the first proactive agent to incorporate prospective memory over everyday sensory contexts for long-horizon proactive assistance. ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions (e.g., egocentric video and audio) into context-aware memory, generating prospective cues and linking earlier events with subsequent developments for future retrieval. Given the current context, it retrieves relevant past events and performs memory-augmented proactive

translated_title: ProMemAgent：基于感知数据的情境感知前瞻性记忆，实现长时程主动辅助
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正从被动响应向主动辅助演进，能够在用户未明确请求的情况下预判其需求。然而，现有的主动式智能体主要应对即时需求，而许多日常场景涉及延迟意图，只能在数小时或数天之后才能付诸行动。人类通过前瞻性记忆来处理这类意图，即在合适的时机出现时记住执行意图的能力。在本文中，我们提出了 ProMemAgent，这是首个将前瞻性记忆融入日常感知情境以实现长时程主动辅助的主动式智能体。ProMemAgent 将过去的感知内容（如第一人称视角的视频和音频）组织成情境感知记忆，生成前瞻性线索，并将先前事件与后续发展关联起来以备未来检索。给定当前情境，它会检索相关的过去事件并执行记忆增强的主动行为。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ProMemAgent 是首个将情境感知的前瞻性记忆引入主动式智能体的工作，它从日常感知数据（如第一人称视频和音频）中组织记忆并生成前瞻性线索，使智能体能够在数小时或数天后的合适时机主动执行延迟意图，实现长时程主动辅助。
en_tdlr: ProMemAgent is the first proactive agent to incorporate context-aware prospective memory over everyday sensory perceptions (e.g., egocentric video and audio), enabling long-horizon proactive assistance by remembering and acting on delayed intentions when the right moment arises.
